column1: # Every local self-government unit (grad or opština) in the Law on Territorial Organization of the Republic of Serbia
# Kosovo and Metohija included. Centers are the coordinates of each seat in Wikidata (CC0).
# English names only where they differ from Serbian. Russian names are transliterated from the official Serbian Cyrillic
# name; review them before a city opens. Locative names are filled in when a city opens (7.7).
# IDs are fixed: never change them once released.
